svg.title: Runtime architecture
svg.desc: Guest access first; optional verified Cognito identity upgrades the same conversation.

g.text: Guest access first; optional verified Cognito identity upgrades the same conversation.
01 / INTRODUCTION AND SESSION ESTABLISHMENT · NO MODEL INVOCATION
Overwrites trusted viewer IP · no cache
Separate public site key in build config
Form + Turnstile token + existing visitor credential
02 / EVERY CHAT REQUEST · SESSION AUTHORISATION BEFORE INFERENCE
Via CloudFront · session token returned to browser
Guest visitor + keyed IP; verified user
Visitor ID persists across conversations; conversation ID groups history; random session token authorises only that conversation.
Guest: 10 questions/UTC day; IP: 3/minute + 50/UTC day. Authenticated: 10/minute + 100/UTC day.
Global: 1,000/UTC day AND 1,000/UTC month. Shared IP/global counters never carry visitor name, company or email.
Private S3 source → Bedrock Knowledge Base ingestion → S3 Vectors is unchanged; Guardrails apply to every answer.
03 / OPTIONAL COGNITO UPGRADE · SAME VISITOR, CONVERSATION AND PENDING QUESTION
The browser restores its transcript and pending question, then sends the rotated session credential through the same chat authorizer.
Verified-user quotas replace guest/IP quotas. Global limits remain. Sign-out closes the session and returns to guest introduction.
Five minutes of inactivity or explicit closure ends the conversation. Retained summaries include sessions that asked no questions.
Solid arrows: request/data flow · Dashed arrows: supporting verification · Browser storage is first-party; third-party cookies are not required for guest chat.
Source: aws/amplify.yaml + amplify.yml | Official AWS Architecture Icons: July 2026 | Logical service architecture; no VPC
